summary: Bohnanza is a card-trading game where you plant and harvest bean cards for coins, but the real game is the constant table talk and negotiation over trades. It's chaotic, social, and shines most as a loud party-ish game with a full table.
praised: Negotiation and trading is genuinely fun and social
Very easy to teach and explain
criticised: Can get chaotic and loud with experienced traders
Runtime can drag at higher player counts
Luck of the draw can hurt players who can't rearrange their hand

interaction.detail: The entire game revolves around open trading and deal-making between players, with almost no private strategy beyond your fixed hand order. The shared trading pool and market are constantly being negotiated over in real time.

scoring.why: The only thing that matters is how many gold coins you've banked from selling harvested bean fields to the market.
scoring.how_you_win: Play beans from the front of your hand into fields you can't rearrange, harvest a field for coins scaled to how many of that bean type you accumulated, and trade or gift beans with opponents to build bigger, more valuable fields than they can; the richest player when the draw deck is exhausted for the third time wins.
